WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 17 (3 days ago)): Drew added Sione Vaki (RB, DET) (dropped Marquise Brown (WR, PHI)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 15 (5 days ago)): Charles added Drew Lock (QB, SEA) for $7 FAAB (dropped Darnell Washington (TE, PIT)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 15 (5 days ago)): Corbishley added Kalif Raymond (WR, CHI) for $9 FAAB (dropped Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI)).

WEEK 1 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Kevin, 139.2-130.8; Adam def. Mitchum, 127.7-120.1; Charles def. Drew, 168.9-116.6 (BLOWOUT); Brent def. Fronge, 126.9-123.5 (NAIL-BITER); Jake def. Wingard, 155.2-123.2; Shaq def. Ryan, 143.9-125.9

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: FINAL from the early window: Corbishley def. Mitchum 83.2-41.3. That is not a football score, that is an audit.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Terrence E. Odom is 3-3 on the season and sitting on a 0-1 locks record. Everyone else who locked in Week 1 is sitting at 1-0. I am not saying the gap is embarrassing. The gap is embarrassing.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I locked Ryan because Ryan is the defending champion with a fine roster and a history of finding ways to win. I stand by the logic. I refuse to stand by the result. Those are two different things and I will die on this hill.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: CHARLES IS PUTTING UP 111.7 ON KEVIN AND THE SUN IS STILL OUT. CROWN at $133.12 and climbing. AT SOME POINT THE REST OF THE EXCHANGE HAS TO LOOK AT THIS SCOREBOARD AND HAVE A CONVERSATION WITH ITSELF.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Fronge is up 59.1-14.2 on Jake in the late window and my power rankings have Fronge ninth. I said somebody was wrong and I did not think it was the projection. I am now watching the projection get proven wrong in real time. I am taking notes. I am not happy about it.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Wingard added DeeJay Dallas and Cooper Rush in the same week and is still down 13.5 to 39.3 against Shaq. I need a segment. Not a tweet. A full segment. Whiteboard, red marker, the works — because the SDR pick-hoarding strategy has now produced a 0-2 record and a waiver wire shopping spree.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Charles as my lock Week 1, hit it, called him number one all offseason, and right now he has 111.7 points on the board before the late games kick off. I called it. The ledger agrees. You can check the ledger.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Fronge up 59-14 on Jake midway through Sunday and my lock record is 0-1 because I had Fronge in Week 1 and Brent beat him by three points. The universe owes me a hit and it is paying out two weeks late.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Ryan is currently beating Drew 41.8 to 27.9 — which should be a relief except the Ledger noted 'a desperate champion' and 'hard hat weather' for Drew, and somehow 41.8 points through most of Sunday feels less like relief and more like Ryan squeaking past the floor.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Adam down 26.0 to 60.2 to Brent at the moment — which is the most interesting live score on the board because Matteo has Adam fifth and Brent eighth, and right now Brent's TE monopoly is the only roster that looks like it knows what day it is.
